Having played the villain in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), Super Creek stayed in character 
even after some time had passed.

Despite her efforts, however, her 
inherently gentle nature had begun to 
shine through and reach many people.

Ahead of the year-end showdown, an 
atmosphere where Super Creek could run as 
her true self... was beginning to take 
shape.
